scope: Read-only analysis of recovered original 0746 baseline whole-phase cumulative snapshots; no new native execution, code edit, policy change or production qualification.
authorization_note: Normal baseline profiling and repair/acceptance are already authorized by the current task. The earlier conditional permission wording was inaccurate; no renewed user confirmation is required. Remaining work concerns evidence, implementation and available resources.
scope_and_difference_rules: Both snapshots belong to the original independent verifier Node: before is post-seed/pre-service, after is after original service cleanup and before final read_active. Whole-phase deltas include ten imports and the separate confirmation; they are not seven-packet prefix-only deltas.

Each of sixteen stage fields is subtracted after exact roster, unsigned/non-saturated, monotonic, known-plus-unknown and unwinding checks. Stage totals are nested and must not be added as exclusive costs.

StageObservation counts on Drop and has no independent started/inflight roster or per-return-error counts. These snapshots prove consistency and known CPU for recorded calls, not an independently enumerated all-started lifecycle.

For every SQL site, both endpoints satisfy started = returned + abandoned + inflight; returned = succeeded + failed; closed = CPU-known + CPU-unknown. All observed errors/unknown/inflight/abandoned/unwinding flags here are zero.

If SQL calls were never entered before, null time is treated as the additive starting identity only to derive later actually-entered calls. A site with no new calls has measured delta time null, even when subtraction of two unchanged cumulative values is numerically zero. Raw endpoint times and arithmetic differences are retained.

SQL intervals cover the actual Transaction::commit API, not all SQL statements, total storage IO or physical fsync. Whole-phase API sum is a conservative upper bound for any subset of those calls in the prefix.

AccountGraph is nested within VerifyState and can run within publish/state_at/read_active/admission/activation. Its wall includes real graph SQL reads, parsing/hash/arithmetic and progress callbacks with Host/CPU/refill checks; their separate costs are not measured here.
Thread CPU excludes full scoped-worker CPU; nested Host, stage and importer CPU are not additive. No wall-minus-CPU residual is labelled as measured sleep.

All runs add 73 AccountGraph calls: 18.138434746 s, 18.667193743 s, 18.420761597 s wall; 4.214790939 s, 4.201382987 s, 4.202289631 s caller CPU. This identifies a concrete measured scope for further profiling, not a decomposition or proof of an algorithmic bottleneck.
